displayName: UE4 volumetric scattering and temporal-history integration
description: Compute pass that combines multiple 3D volumetric inputs with reprojected history and stores an integrated scattering/extinction volume.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified live at event 811 over a 120x68x96 volume.

checks.meaning: Froxel-volume compute dispatch shape used by the verified pass.
Current broad injection, temporal history, and local-light injection are 3D textures.
The pass writes an integrated float4 scattering/extinction volume.
At least two current-frame volumetric sources are loaded by froxel coordinate.
Reprojected temporal history is sampled at a transformed coordinate.
The temporal section forms a history-minus-current or current-minus-history difference.
Reprojected 3D history is differenced and blended through a bounded instruction sequence; the numeric weight is adapter-specific.
The integrated float4 result is stored to the 3D UAV.

runtimeContract.output: RWTexture3D<float4> scattering RGB plus extinction A
runtimeContract.temporalWeightScope: FF7RemakeIntergrade verified adapter values; other semantic matches must recover and validate their own blend weights.

temporalWeightValidation.eligibilityRule: Steady-state compensation requires a fixed temporal blend contract whose recovered current/history weights match the adapter binding.
temporalWeightValidation.failClosedRule: A dynamic or unresolved temporal coefficient is semantically compatible with this pass family but is ineligible for FF7-style steady-state compensation.

postControlSynthesis.controlledChannels: RGB scattering only; preserve extinction alpha
postControlSynthesis.adapterRequirement: Confirm the pass output feeds the next frame's temporal-history input before applying compensation.
